ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Deep Diving
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
SCALD_DIVING_MOD_1 (owner ruling, 2026-09-12, on the Scald kit's open card 3, verbatim: "Diving interaction, and make the diving mod v1 content now!!"). `scald_kit_spec.md` S5 ruled: "the bottom-walkers do not stay a visual: a diving mechanic (hunt/commune at the deep center, priced in burns) ships as v1 content, as its own RimMandrake-tier mod." Ban 4 in `the_scald.md` ("no macro-life in the boil itself") is superseded exactly this far: the DEEP interaction exists; the boiling SURFACE remains strictly no-swim — this mod never lets a pawn stand where the boil ban applies.
**The generic mechanism (this mod's actual surface, RM-tier because it names no biome, no clan, no planet):** any TerrainDef tagged `RM_DiveEligible` and Standable becomes a place a colonist can be sent to dive. Right-click such a cell for "Dive to hunt" or "Dive to commune" — the pawn walks there and holds position for a tunable duration. No new damage system: the pawn pays in burns because RimWorld's own `HediffGiver_Terrain` already fires on any pawn standing on a `burnDamage`-carrying terrain (Core's `HediffGiverSets.xml`) — this mod's only job is getting a colonist to stand there on purpose and paying out an outcome afterward. A medieval-tribe player could tag a lava-adjacent tile and use this alone; it does not know the Scald exists.
**Why a dive SITE, not a bottom-walker pawn:** `scald_kit_spec.md` S5 ships v1 walkers only as a non-resident surfacing set-piece (`RUT_WalkerSurfacing`/`RUT_IncidentWorker_WalkerSurfacing`, elsewhere) — `measure`/RimSage confirm ZERO bottom-walker PawnKindDef or ThingDef exists in the live def set. Simulating a full swimming, huntable pawn AI for a creature that has no def, no art, and an explicit "not a resident pawn" ruling would invent lore this mod is not chartered to invent. The dive-site interaction point delivers the ruled player experience (reach the deep center, risk the burn, come back with something or someone changed) without that invention; the roster/bestiary pass can attach a real pawnkind to the same cells later without touching this mod.
**Wiring to the Scald (data only, this mod owns no Scald lore):** a single PatchOperationAdd, gated `MayRequire="mandrake.rut.patches"`, adds the `RM_DiveEligible` tag to `RUT_ScaldWaterMovingChestDeep` and `RUT_ScaldWaterShallow`/`RUT_ScaldWaterMovingShallow` (Standable boiling terrain at the crater's edge — `RUT_ScaldWaterDeep`/`OceanDeep` are Impassable to walking pawns and carry no tag, so the interaction can never place a colonist ON the boiling surface itself; ban 4 holds). Absent that mod, this mod ships inert but complete.
**Mod Settings** (MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine): master on/off, hunt/commune on/off independently, dive duration (the actual burn-exposure dial — it multiplies how many of the terrain's own burnIntervalTicks the pawn eats), per-cell cooldown, hunt success/lashback chances, hunt yield range, and the commune mood value. Every default matches this description's shipped numbers.
